nodes.name: Webhook - intake-to-ado
nodes.notes: Receives the portable payload from twapp's /intake-to-ado skill. Body shape: { feat_id, work_item_type, title, description, acceptance, tags, assignee, area, iteration }.

nodes.name: Verify X-Jytte-Internal-Secret
nodes.notes: Matches the jytte-main -> n8n auth convention documented in deploy/n8n/README.md.

nodes.name: Compile ADO JSON Patch
nodes.notes: The skill sends a language-agnostic payload; this node knows the ADO field paths. If ADO field mapping changes, only this node is edited.

nodes.name: POST to ADO wit/workitems

httpBasicAuth.name: ADO PAT (basic, empty user, PAT as password)

nodes.notes: AZDO_PAT_TRUSTWORKS lives in the ado-pat credential (basic auth, empty username, PAT as password). Never edit this node to log the auth header or the raw response with the credential in it - use fullResponse: true only so we can inspect status codes downstream.

meta.description: Consumes the portable payload from twapp's /intake-to-ado skill, verifies the X-Jytte-Internal-Secret header against JYTTE_INTERNAL_SECRET, compiles an ADO JSON Patch, POSTs it to https://dev.azure.com/${AZDO_ORG_TRUSTWORKS}/${AZDO_PROJECT_TRUSTWORKS}/_apis/wit/workitems using the ado-pat credential, and returns { id, url } to the caller. Non-2xx from ADO propagates as { upstream_status, upstream_excerpt }.
